reading: 8/8 pages in the rail render their own heading with the browser context offline, after a single online visit to the landing page.

19 hashed assets are held, 6 of them font files. The font count is the one worth watching: those files are named only inside the stylesheets, so a worker that precached the documents and the chunks would report every page working and render all of them in a system font.
A page that was never visited online falls back to /offline.html, which lists the pages that are held, rather than to the browser's own error page.
